bash: echo "== entry points =="; pip --version 2>&1; python3 -m pip --version 2>&1; /usr/local/bin/pip3.13 --version 2>&1
echo; echo "== module imports =="; python3 -c "import pip, pip._internal.cli.main; print('import ok ->', pip.__version__)" 2>&1
echo; echo "== RECORD vs reality =="
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, csv
sp = "/usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages"
di = os.path.join(sp, "pip-24.3.1.dist-info", "RECORD")
missing = present = 0
for row in csv.reader(open(di)):
    if not row: continue
    p = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(sp, row[0]))
    if os.path.exists(p): present += 1
    else: missing += 1
print(f"present={present} missing={missing}")
EOF

import zipfile, os

    "Metadata-Version: 2.1\nName: demo-pkg\nVersion: 0.1\n")
open("/tmp/wh/demo_pkg-0.1.dist-info/WHEEL","w").write(
    "Wheel-Version: 1.0\nGenerator: manual\nRoot-Is-Purelib: true\nTag: py3-none-any\n")
rec = ["demo_pkg.py,,",
       "demo_pkg-0.1.dist-info/METADATA,,",
       "demo_pkg-0.1.dist-info/WHEEL,,",
       "demo_pkg-0.1.dist-info/RECORD,,"]
open("/tmp/wh/demo_pkg-0.1.dist-info/RECORD","w").write("\n".join(rec)+"\n")
p="/tmp/whl/demo_pkg-0.1-py3-none-any.whl"
with zipfile.ZipFile(p,"w") as z:
    for root,_,files in os.walk("/tmp/wh"):
        for f in files:
            full=os.path.join(root,f)
            z.write(full, os.path.relpath(full,"/tmp/wh"))
print("built", p)
EOF
echo "== INSTALL =="
